cues.en: Mike: As I mentioned in the previous video, there is a lot about these ROC curves that you have, in fact, already learned, so there isn't a whole lot of novelty here.
cues.zh: Mike：就像上一部影片提到的，關於 ROC 曲線，你其實已經學過很多，因此這裡沒有太多新內容。

cues.en: ROC curves are about drawing these iso contour curves in this yes space.
cues.zh: ROC 曲線就是在這個「是」空間中畫等值曲線。

cues.en: So where we have hits and false alarms in as axes of this graph.
cues.zh: 也就是以命中與誤報作為圖的座標軸。

cues.en: So what I want to do in this video is take the opportunity to show you some of the, let's call it, annoyances, that can arise when you're trying to translate statistics
cues.zh: 這部影片中，我想趁機展示，把統計從理論，也就是像黑板上的概念，

cues.en: from theoretical like chalkboard concepts where I just put a picture up on the screen in front of you, into code that you actually implement in computers.
cues.zh: 從我在螢幕上放一張圖給你看，轉成真正在電腦上實作的程式時，可能遇到的一些小麻煩。

cues.en: So you'll see what that means in a few moments.
cues.zh: 稍後你就會了解我的意思。

cues.en: I'm gonna start by basically just recreating stuff that we've already seen.
cues.zh: 首先，基本上只是重現已經看過的內容。

cues.en: So these are the D prime and response bias matrices that you've already learned about in the past few lectures.
cues.zh: 這些是過去幾堂課學過的 d′ 與反應偏誤矩陣。

cues.en: Here, I'm going to plot those two spaces.
cues.zh: 這裡，我要畫出這兩個空間。

cues.en: Again, nothing new, just copy and pasting these lines of code from the previous couple of videos.
cues.zh: 一樣，沒有新內容，只是從前幾部影片複製貼上這些程式。

cues.en: So here we see the ROC space, we have the hit rate and the false alarm rate.
cues.zh: 這裡看到 ROC 空間，有命中率與誤報率。

cues.en: This is illustrating D prime, and this is illustrating response bias.
cues.zh: 這邊呈現 d′，這邊呈現反應偏誤。

cues.en: Okay, so what I want to do now is draw the ROC curves, draw these iso contour lines where D prime is constant and response bias is constant.
cues.zh: 現在我要畫 ROC 曲線，也就是 d′ 固定以及反應偏誤固定的等值線。

cues.en: Now, if we were evaluating these theoretically using a formula, that would be one thing we could just write down the formula and convert that into lines.
cues.zh: 如果用公式從理論上求值，那是一回事；直接寫下公式，再轉成線就可以了。

cues.en: But what I wanna do here is convert these into empirical iso contour lines and show you how you know one of the ways that we can translate an analytic solution
cues.zh: 但這裡我要把它們轉成實測的等值線，展示將解析解轉成

cues.en: into an empirical solution.
cues.zh: 實測解的一種方式。

cues.en: So what I want to do is draw D prime iso contours at 0.3, 0.5, 0.9, and 1.5.
So you already saw what these lines are going to look like from the previous video.
cues.zh: 上一部影片中，你已經看過這些線會長什麼樣子。

cues.en: You know, they're gonna draw up something like this.
cues.zh: 它們會畫成大致這樣。

cues.en: They're gonna follow this trace around here.
cues.zh: 會沿著這裡的軌跡。

cues.en: So again, these are the lines where we have constant D prime, so the same value of D prime for very different hit rates and false alarm rates.
cues.zh: 同樣地，這些都是 d′ 固定的線，因此非常不同的命中率與誤報率，對應同一個 d′ 值。

cues.en: So the way that I'm implementing this is to look through and find all of the values that are within some tolerance of these values, 0.3.
cues.zh: 我的實作方式，是找出所有落在這些數值某個容許誤差範圍內的值，例如 0.3。

cues.en: Now, why do we need to worry about this tolerance business?
cues.zh: 為什麼需要考慮容許誤差？

cues.en: Well, that's because, if we look at this matrix, we have a really high precision matrix, so D prime.
cues.zh: 因為看看這個矩陣，d′ 矩陣的精度非常高。

cues.en: You can see how much precision is actually in the elements of this matrix.
cues.zh: 你可以看到，矩陣元素實際具有多少位精度。

cues.en: And that's because, you know, we get these as probability values, they're transformed into zed score values.
cues.zh: 這是因為這些原本是機率值，再轉成 Z 分數。

cues.en: And so we end up with numbers in this matrix that are as precise as our computer is comfortable representing.
cues.zh: 因此，矩陣中的數值會精確到電腦能夠正常表示的程度。

cues.en: So there in fact is no value in this matrix at exactly .3.
cues.zh: 所以，這個矩陣中其實沒有恰好等於 0.3 的值。

cues.en: We cannot find a value in this matrix that has a D prime value of exactly 0.3.
cues.zh: 我們無法在這個矩陣中找到 d′ 恰好等於 0.3 的值。

cues.en: This one's pretty close, you know, it's minus, but there's gonna be a corresponding one over here.
cues.zh: 這個很接近，雖然它是負的，但這邊會有一個對應的正值。

cues.en: So, but it's 0.30306 and so on.
So instead, what we're going to do is find values in the D prime matrix that are between the D prime value that we want
cues.zh: 因此，我們改成在 d′ 矩陣中找出，介於所需 d′ 值

cues.en: minus this tolerance, -0.01, and that same D prime value plus 0.01.
cues.zh: 減去容許誤差，也就是減 0.01，以及同一個 d′ 值加 0.01 之間的值。

cues.en: So we're basically going to be looking around within a specific tolerance.
cues.zh: 基本上，就是在特定容許誤差範圍內尋找。

cues.en: We find those indices into the matrix.
cues.zh: 找出這些值在矩陣中的索引。

cues.en: And actually we can, lemme run this here to make sure that this is clear.
cues.zh: 其實，讓我執行這裡，確保說明清楚。

cues.en: So we start off looking for 0.3, and then I can say D prime of IDX.
cues.zh: 首先尋找 0.3，接著我可以取 d′ 的 IDX 索引位置。

cues.en: And you can see all of these values are not exactly equal to 0.3.
cues.zh: 你可以看到，這些值都不完全等於 0.3。

cues.en: But they are D prime values that are really, really close to 0.3, and I think that's good enough.
cues.zh: 但它們都是非常、非常接近 0.3 的 d′ 值，我認為這樣已經夠好了。

cues.en: And then those are the values that get plotted.
cues.zh: 接著就把這些值畫出來。

cues.en: We plot lines for their false alarm rates and their hit rates.
cues.zh: 按照它們的誤報率與命中率畫線。

cues.en: So, with all that said, here is what that produces.
cues.zh: 說明完之後，產生的結果就是這樣。

cues.en: So here you see the empirical D prime iso contour lines.
cues.zh: 這裡看到的是實測的 d′ 等值線。

cues.en: The dots show the actual values that got identified, and then there's lines drawn between them.
cues.zh: 這些點顯示實際辨識出的數值，接著在點與點之間畫線。

cues.en: So this red line here is corresponds to the iso contour of 0.3, and then here in the blue line is 0.5, and then 0.9.
cues.zh: 這裡的紅線對應 0.3 的等值線，藍線是 0.5，接著是 0.9。

cues.en: And here is the D prime value of 1.5.
cues.zh: 這裡則是 d′ 等於 1.5。

cues.en: So this demonstrates empirically that we get a range of D prime values that are all the same for very different hit rates and false alarm rates.
cues.zh: 這以實測方式展示，在非常不同的命中率與誤報率下，可以得到同樣的 d′ 值。

cues.en: And here I have the same values, except now it's not D prime, now it's response bias.
cues.zh: 這裡使用相同的值，但現在不是 d′，而是反應偏誤。

cues.en: So it's also interesting to see how these response bias and D prime iso contours are, they're kind of crossing each other.
cues.zh: 看到反應偏誤與 d′ 等值線彼此交叉，也很有意思。

cues.en: So here I have a lot of code that you've already seen before.
cues.zh: 這裡有很多你先前看過的程式。

cues.en: So this is code that creates the D prime matrix and the response bias matrix literally copied and pasted from previous lectures.
cues.zh: 這是建立 d′ 矩陣與反應偏誤矩陣的程式，直接從前面課程複製貼上。

cues.en: And here we have also the visualization code here is the same as what you saw before.
cues.zh: 這裡的視覺化程式，也和先前看過的一樣。

cues.en: So just creating images of those matrices.
cues.zh: 就是把那些矩陣畫成影像。

cues.en: Now what we're going to do that's new here is draw the iso contour lines for various D prime and response bias values on top of those plots.
cues.zh: 現在這裡的新作法，是在這些圖上，畫出不同 d′ 與反應偏誤值的等值線。

cues.en: This is like what I showed in the slides in the previous video.
cues.zh: 就像上一部影片中，我在投影片裡展示的那樣。

cues.en: So I'm going to show D prime and also bias values of 0.3, 0.5, 0.9, and 1.5.
cues.zh: 我要顯示 0.3、0.5、0.9 與 1.5 的 d′ 與偏誤值。

cues.en: Now the thing is, because the precision of these matrices is really high, we're not actually gonna get any values in this matrix at exactly 0.3.
cues.zh: 問題是，這些矩陣的精度很高，所以矩陣裡實際上不會有恰好等於 0.3 的值。

cues.en: It could be, you know, 0.3060247, whatever.
But it's not going to be exactly 0.3.
cues.zh: 但不會恰好是 0.3。

cues.en: And that's because these are empirical matrices.
cues.zh: 因為這些是實測矩陣。

cues.en: We're not deriving these values from a formula.
cues.zh: 我們並不是從公式推導這些值。

cues.en: So the way that I am solving this here is by coming up with a tolerance.
cues.zh: 因此，我在這裡的解決方式是設定容許誤差。

cues.en: And then we're gonna say that we're looking for any points in this matrix that are within some tolerance of 0.3.
cues.zh: 接著尋找矩陣中，與 0.3 的差距落在某個容許誤差範圍內的點。

cues.en: So basically any points that are really close to 0.3.
cues.zh: 基本上，就是非常接近 0.3 的點。

cues.en: So that's what I implement here.
cues.zh: 這就是這裡實作的內容。

cues.en: I'm looping over the different values of the D prime that we are going to be searching for.
cues.zh: 我用迴圈走過要搜尋的各個 d′ 值。

cues.en: And I say, basically, you know, find all of the points where the elements in a D prime matrix are greater than the requested D prime value
cues.zh: 基本上，就是找出 d′ 矩陣中所有元素，大於所需 d′ 值

cues.en: minus the tolerance and less than the requested D prime value plus that tolerance.
cues.zh: 減去容許誤差，而且小於所需 d′ 值加上容許誤差的位置。

cues.en: So, essentially it is saying all the D prime points that are in between the D prime value plus or minus that tolerance value.
cues.zh: 也就是所有落在 d′ 值正負容許誤差範圍內的 d′ 點。

cues.en: Okay, and then same thing for bias.
cues.zh: 偏誤也是一樣的做法。

cues.en: So let's see what this matrix looks like.
cues.zh: 來看看這個矩陣的樣子。

cues.en: So here we see the D prime space and the response bias space.
cues.zh: 這裡看到 d′ 空間與反應偏誤空間。

cues.en: And you see here are the D prime iso contours for 0.3, this blue line was 0.5, here we have 0.9, and this was the D prime iso contour for 1.5.
cues.zh: 這裡是 0.3 的 d′ 等值線，這條藍線是 0.5，這裡是 0.9，而這條是 1.5 的 d′ 等值線。

cues.en: So it's pretty interesting to see that as the D prime gets larger, they start getting, you know, they start like hugging these axes a little bit more, they get closer and closer to the axes.
cues.zh: 很有意思的是，隨著 d′ 越來越大，曲線開始更貼近這些座標軸，越靠越近。

cues.en: As we get closer to zero, of course it's gonna go more towards the diagonal.
cues.zh: 當越接近零時，當然就會更接近對角線。

cues.en: It's also interesting to see that the D prime and the response bias for the same levels, the same iso contours, are forming in this kind of opposing diagonal manner.
cues.zh: 另一點也很有意思，同樣水準、同樣等值的 d′ 與反應偏誤曲線，會形成方向相反的對角走向。

cues.en: This again shows you that the D prime and the response bias, individually, are insufficient to, they don't provide enough information to cover this entire space.
cues.zh: 這再次顯示，單獨使用 d′ 或反應偏誤，都不充分，提供的資訊不足以涵蓋整個空間。

cues.en: Instead, what we need to do is combine D prime and response bias in order to understand or to model every point in the signal detection theory space.
cues.zh: 我們必須結合 d′ 與反應偏誤，才能理解或建模訊號偵測理論空間中的每一個點。
